title: GraphBit：基于图的非线性能体编排框架
summary: GraphBit 是一种引擎编排的框架，将工作流定义为有向无环图（DAG），代理作为类型化函数运行，由 Rust 引擎管理路由、状态转换和工具调用，确保可重复性和可审计性。支持并行分支执行、条件控制流和三层记忆架构，在 GAIA 基准测试中准确率达 67.6%，零框架幻觉，延迟仅 11.9 毫秒，吞吐量最高。
summary_en: GraphBit is an engine-orchestrated framework that defines workflows as DAGs, with agents as typed functions managed by a Rust engine for routing, state transitions, and tool invocation, ensuring reproducibility and auditability. It supports parallel branch execution, conditional control flow, and a three-tier memory architecture, achieving 67.6% accuracy on GAIA benchmarks with zero framework-induced hallucinations, 11.9 ms latency, and highest throughput.
